chainRootRecurrence.baseCase: rootAtDepth(1) = baseRoot(actual accepted base artifact digest, actual source fold envelope digest, actual NumiSeal proof envelope digest, accepted producer envelope digest, and actual public statement digest)
chainRootRecurrence.stepCase: for depth 1 <= d < 3, rootAtDepth(d + 1) = stepRoot(d, rootAtDepth(d), parent artifact digest, parent source fold envelope digest, parent product proof envelope digest, accepted producer envelope digest, parent public statement digest, consumer session digest, recomputed context root, recomputed replay root, and typed carry statements)
chainRootRecurrence.verifierProcedure: NumiSealProductVerifier.verify recomputes the child chain root from the loaded verified parent chain root and actual loaded parent/context/replay/proof material before accepting recursive artifacts
chainRootRecurrence.extractorProcedure: NumiSealProductConcreteExtractor consumes verifier-computed productCarryChainRoot values; it does not accept a recursive root merely claimed in artifact metadata

extractorInterface.target: accepted product proof envelopes and their bound source fold, terminal seal, ZK residual, and recursive carry context material
extractorInterface.rewindingModel: deterministic post-acceptance verifier replay over bound CTCO proof envelopes; cryptographic CTCO online extraction remains a per-kind theorem assumption, not an additional Swift replay loss
acceptedInputBindings: trace extractor CTCO root and challenge seed
recursive carry context root when carry mode is typed-required

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero residual Swift extractor loss: accepted source fold verification replays the bound proof envelope and exports public output claims deterministically; CTCO knowledge extraction remains charged in the per-kind theorem assumptions
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: NumiSealProductConcreteExtractor replays source fold verification and recomputes source-fold-output-claim digests from proof-envelope bytes

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero residual Swift extractor loss: accepted NumiSeal terminal or ZK product verification replays lane aggregation, residual openings, component-root binding, and transcript digest deterministically
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: NumiSealProductConcreteExtractor replays terminal proof acceptance and checks public statement, obligation, lane-summary, aggregate, component-root, and proof-transcript digests

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero residual Swift extractor loss: the product artifact binds source fold output claims, obligations, verifier policy, trusted context, and terminal public statement roots into one replay digest
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: swiftConcreteExtractorEvidenceDigest metadata is generated by the prover and recomputed by NumiSealProductConcreteExtractor over source/product headers, public output claims, obligations, trace evidence, and QROM evidence

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero residual Swift extractor loss at selected depth 3 because both recursive carry hops are replayed from verifier-computed productCarryChainRoot values and typed carry statements already accepted by the terminal verifier
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: NumiSealProductVerifier.verify returns productCarryChainRoot; recursive parent construction rejects metadata-only recursive parents; recursive-carry-chain-root is CTCO-bound in product trace evidence

lossRule.selectedDepthExpression: epsilon_extract(depth=3) = 0 after deterministic accepted-product replay over source fold, terminal/ZK proof, product envelope, and loaded recursive carry chain roots; cryptographic CTCO extraction remains charged in per-kind theorem assumptions
lossRule.recursivePromotionExpression: epsilon_extract(depth=d) = d * 0 for selected replay extraction plus max(d - 1, 0) * epsilon_extract_carry until promoted typed carry extraction is instantiated
